subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Dignify
solution: The correct answer is **"Condemn."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Dignify"** means to give honor or respect to something or someone. ((कुछ) योग्य और प्रभावशाली बनाना) • **Example**: *Tragic literature **dignifies**__ sorrow and disaster.* • **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval or criticism towards something or someone. (किसी की तीव्र निंदा करना; दोषी या अपराधी ठहराना) __ • **Example**: *A government spokesman **condemned**__ the bombing as a cowardly act of terrorism.* • Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of **dignify** is **condemn**. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ ** • **Option 2 (Adorn)** means to decorate or add beauty to something. (अधिक आकर्षक या मोहक बनाने के लिए सजाना) • **Option 3 (Oblige)** means to make someone legally or morally bound to do something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को बाध्य करना (किसी काम के लिए)) • **Option 4 (Cure)** means to heal or treat an illness or problem. ((रोगी को) पुनः स्‍वस्‍थ कर देना; रोगमुक्त करना) 3a:Tb50, The correct answer is** "gild."**
